trap.label: past perfect
trap.wrong: He noticed that a mold contaminated the plate.
trap.right: He noticed that a mold had contaminated the plate.
trap.why: Em português “notou que um fungo contaminara/contaminou” confunde as ordens. Em inglês, a ação anterior a outro passado usa past perfect.

opts: He noticed; then the plate was contaminated.
The mold contaminated the plate; then he noticed.

fix.wrong: She found that the colony inhibit growth.
fix.right: She found that the colony inhibited growth.

fix.wrong: They isolate it after it had grown.
fix.right: They isolated it after it had grown.

fix.wrong: The compound purified by the team.
fix.right: The compound was purified by the team.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com past perfect: “He saw that the colony grew.” (had grown)
rewrite.answer: He saw that the colony had grown.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com past perfect: “She noticed that the mold grew.”
rewrite.answer: She noticed that the mold had grown.
The colony was isolated by the team.
